details:
In its current state, I've had some issues trying to make an update workflow for my avatars. I found a great error in the body mesh of my avatars and in my effort to update over 20 (and upload several new ones) of them, I found that the dropdown menu sorting for the build tab in the VRCSDK seemingly does not exist, or is nonsensical.

I'd like it to either copy the hierarchy of the Scene Hierarchy (which would be the most sensible) or Alphabetically (Which is also sensible). If it's using something cryptic like avatar ID, that means my sorting ends up at the whim of the SDK itself, which is unfortunate and awkward to navigate. 

>But just hide the avatars

Well, I kinda need the ones I HAVEN'T uploaded to be on for sorting's sake. I'm already maintaining over ten categorized scenes in my unity project including one just for staging models, and one for copying physbone settings, constraints, and other things. My staging one is just really large right now so I can keep track of what the heck I need to do, and it is absolutely JUST the SDK dropdown menu that is fighting me.

A simple sort-by would be a godsend right now.
title: How is the SDK Avatar Builder sorted?
